# zzzshawn/matrix local sources

This directory stores local copies of the 20 upstream square loaders from
`https://github.com/zzzzshawn/matrix`.

The `/text` thinking indicator uses a lightweight app-native implementation
in `src/app/components/TextThinkingMatrixLoader.tsx`, with animation variants
mapped to `dotm-square-1.tsx` through `dotm-square-20.tsx`.

The downloaded upstream files are kept here for traceability and are not
compiled as application source.
